title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Co. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The steering rods can separate, causing the driver to lose steering control. This could cause the ATV to crash and pose a risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 200,000.

title: CPSC, Maytag Corp. Announce Recall of Hoover Self-Propelled Upright Vacuum Cleaners
summary: The recalled vacuums have defective on-off switches that can overheat the handle and toolholder areas of the vacuum, resulting in a fire hazard. Units: About 636,000.

title: CPSC, Baja Products Announce Recall of My First Crayon-Balls™ and My First Crayon-Ball™ Activity Sets
summary: Small crayon balls can break loose from the plastic base of the products. This can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 145,000.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Karaoke Cassette Player/Recorders
summary: The paint on the five control buttons of the karaoke player contains excessive lead, posing a lead poisoning hazard to young children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems, and growth retardation. Units: About 220,000.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corp., U.S.A. Announce Recall Reminder for Off-Road Motorcycles and ATVs
summary: The rear brake shoe material could separate due to improper adhesive curing, adversely affecting rear braking performance. Units: About 2,755 PW80 and TT-R90 Off-Road Motorcycles and about 850 Grizzly 125 ATVs.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corporation, U.S.A. Announce Recall Reminder for ATVs
summary: Vibration from the engine and driveline during long periods of high rpm usage could cause the rear master cylinder reservoir to agitate, resulting in brake fluid aeration. A small amount of air bubbles could enter the master cylinder, adversely affecting rear brake performance. Units: About 86,000.

title: CPSC, Zebco Announce Recall of Children's Fishing Poles
summary: The paint on the rods of these fishing poles contains lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 1.5 million fishing poles.

title: CPSC, Sears Roebuck and Co. Announce Recall of Table Saw Rip Fences
summary: The rip fence - a metal guide that keeps material being sawed from shifting side to side as it passes through the cutting blade - can come loose. This could result in kickback of the material being sawed and possible injury to the operator. Units: About 41,800.

title: CPSC, Solar Inc. Announce Recall of Flashing Toy Pacifiers
summary: The nipple can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 24,000.

title: CPSC, L.L. Bean Inc. Announce Recall of Director's Chairs, Replacement Seats
summary: The wooden dowels in the fabric seats are too small and can break or slide out of the fabric sleeves; the fabric seat can tear from the wooden seat frame; and the chair frame also can break at the backrest upright, the armrest and at the leg axis. title: CPSC, DESA Heating Products and Scheu Manufacturing Co. Announce Recall of Propane Heaters
summary: The plastic ring on the heater's regulator can crack, causing gas to leak out if the propane tank and heater regulator are turned on. This can create a fire hazard if an ignition source is present. Units: About 88,000.

title: CPSC, Hunter's View Announce Recall of Safety Harnesses Sold with Tree Stands
summary: The harnesses could fail during use, resulting in consumers falling from tree stands and suffering serious injuries or death. Units: About 500,000.

title: CPSC, Southern Living At HOME Announce Recall of Tea Light Candles
summary: Some of these tea light candles from one production run can burn with a high flame, due to contamination. Units: 3,480.

title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The fuel petcock inserts were made with incorrect material, that does not correctly bond the fuel tank and petcock insert, which could allow fuel leakage. If this occurs, a fire hazard with the possibility of injury and property damage could result. Units: About 1,540.

title: CPSC, Atico International USA Announce Recall of Children's Folding Chairs
summary: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cut hazard. This can cause severe lacerations and fingertip amputations to children's fingers. Units: A

title: CPSC, Bell & Gossett Announce Recall of Dual Unit Valves
summary: Burn injury from a hot water leak. Units: 1,500.

title: CPSC, Heat & Glo Announce Recall of Gas Fireplaces
summary: Gas in the fireplace can accumulate prior to burner ignition. When ignition takes place, it can cause the glass window to shatter and create a risk of burns or lacerations from broken glass. Units: About 7,800.

title: CPSC, J.C. Penney Corp. Announce Recall of Children's Bodysuits
summary: The appliqué can detach from the garment, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 228,818 (56,922 newborn-size and 171,896 infant size).

title: CPSC, Royal Seating Ltd. Announce Recall of Children's Chairs
summary: The seat portion of the chair can detach from the leg base, possibly causing a child to fall to the floor. Units: About 46,000.

title: CPSC, Sharp Electronics Corp. Announce Recall of Conventional Tube Televisions
summary: The power button can break, allowing objects to be inserted through the opening. Foreign materials, such as crayons, metal objects or straws, can ignite posing a fire hazard. Units: About 373,000.

title: CPSC and Global Gift Industries Announce Recall of Martha Stewart Everyday Brand Flowerpot Candle Sets Sold Exclusively at Kmart
summary: These candles can have a high flame, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: 16,000 sets.

title: CPSC, California International Trading Announce Recall of Pacifiers and Two Electronic Toys
summary: The pacifiers and toys can easily break apart, exposing small parts. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Carter's Announce Recall of Carter's Brand Children's Overalls
summary: The plastic center of the decorative snaps on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 31,000.
